title: Oracle Morning Brief
script_summary: Bitcoin holds at 63,986 dollars, down 0.3 percent, while fear sits at 27 on the index. Hashrate stays firm at 822.8 EH/s, showing miners are not backing off. Mempool carries 76,000 transactions with fees pinned at one sat per vbyte. Asia session delivered little movement overnight. Watch for a push above 64,500 or a slip toward 63,000 support through the day. Block height stands at 962,124.
